function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the complete content of a file from the disk.

path.description: The path to the file to read.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or overwrite content to a file on disk. Creates the file and folders if they do not exist.

path.description: The path of the file to write.

content.description: The exact text content to write into the file.

function.name: file_glob_search
function.description: Search for files in a directory.

path.description: The base directory to search in.

function.name: get_datetime
function.description: Get the current date and time.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for information using a search query.

query.description: The search terms to look up.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch and extract the main text content of a specific web page.

url.description: The target website URL to read.

function.name: web_browse
function.description: Navigate and capture screenshot or execute simple actions in a dynamic web page.

url.description: The target website URL to navigate to.

proxy.description: Optional proxy URL (e.g. '127.0.0.1:9080' for Tor HTTP, or 'socks5://127.0.0.1:9050'). Set to null or false to connect directly.

screenshot_path.description: Optional file path to capture and save a PNG screenshot.
